lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Are you looking for a job?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 是的，我上个星期离开公司了。
lines.pinyin: Shì de, wǒ shàng gè xīngqī líkāi gōngsī le.
lines.english: Yes, I left the company last week.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 钱太少，又太忙。我想找个更好的。
lines.pinyin: Qián tài shǎo, yòu tài máng. Wǒ xiǎng zhǎo gè gèng hǎo de.
lines.english: The pay is too little and it's too busy. I want to find a better one.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What kind of job do you want?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我想在大公司做经理。或者做老师也可以。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài dà gōngsī zuò jīnglǐ. Huòzhě zuò lǎoshī yě kěyǐ.
lines.english: I want to be a manager at a big company. Or being a teacher is also okay.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 发了一些。下个星期有两个面试。
lines.pinyin: Fā le yīxiē. Xià gè xīngqī yǒu liǎng gè miànshì.
lines.english: I sent some out. Next week I have two interviews.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 希望你的面试很好，早点找到好工作！
lines.pinyin: Xīwàng nǐ de miànshì hěn hǎo, zǎodiǎn zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò!
lines.english: I hope your interviews go well and you find a good job soon!
